name: Clean Launcher
desc: Perfect launch: Power x1.10 for the race.

name: Shift Savant
desc: Each Perfect shift: +3% Power for the rest of the race.

name: Double Clutch
desc: Each Perfect shift: Gearing x1.05, compounding.

name: Redline Gambler
desc: Perfect window 40% narrower. Perfect shifts give Power x1.25 for that gear.

name: Sticky Compound
desc: Grip x1.15 while in 1st gear.

name: Featherweight
desc: Weight x0.95.

name: Boost Brain
desc: Forced induction and nitrous parts count 50% stronger.

name: Garage Rat
desc: +2% Power per slot with a non-Stock part.

name: Cash Cow
desc: Earn $2 per Perfect grade in a race.

name: Finish Line Flair
desc: Win by less than 0.1 s: earn $5.

name: Hot Streak
desc: Perfect shifts in a row give +4%, +8%, then +12% Power; anything else resets the streak.

name: Perfectionist
desc: Power x1.30 until your first non-Perfect shift, then x0.90 for the rest of the race.

name: Rev Matcher
desc: Each Perfect shift: Power x1.12 for that gear.

name: Tightrope
desc: Shift window 25% narrower, but each Perfect shift gives +7% Power.

name: Second Wind
desc: After a MISS shift: Power x1.30 for that gear.

name: Shift Light
desc: Shift window x1.15.

name: Perfect Record
desc: +1% Power for every Perfect grade earned in won races while owned.

name: All or Nothing
desc: Power x1.40, but any MISS shift ends the race as a loss.

name: Quick Draw
desc: Launch timing windows 30% wider and Grip x1.08 in 1st gear.

name: Holeshot
desc: Perfect launch: Grip x1.20 in 1st gear and earn $2.

name: Burnout Box
desc: Grip x1.12 for the first 2 seconds.

name: Torque Monster
desc: Power and Grip x1.10 in 1st and 2nd gear.

name: Slingshot
desc: Perfect launch: Power and Grip x1.15 through 1st and 2nd gear.

name: Hot Mix
desc: Nitrous power x1.5 and it fires 0.5 s longer.

name: Wet Shot
desc: Nitrous power x2, but it fires 25% shorter.

name: Spooled Up
desc: +40 Power if you run both a forced induction and a nitrous part.

name: Natural Aspiration
desc: No forced induction and no nitrous part: Power x1.20.

name: Late Spray
desc: Fire nitrous in 3rd gear or later: +10% Power for the rest of the race.

name: Blow-Off Valve
desc: With a forced induction part, each Perfect shift gives +4% Power.

name: Nest Egg
desc: Entering a shop: earn $1 per $10 you hold (max $3).

name: Piggy Bank
desc: Gains $2 of sell value at every shop.

name: Sponsor Decal
desc: Earn $2 for every won race.

name: Bargain Hunter
desc: Rerolls cost $1 less.

name: Day Off
desc: Skipping a race earns $4.

name: Scrap Dealer
desc: Selling a part or passive earns $2 extra.

name: Prize Fighter
desc: Boss wins earn $6 extra.

name: Golden Wrench
desc: Each win earns $1 for every 2 non-Stock parts installed.

name: Momentum
desc: +2% Power for each race won while owned.

name: Trophy Case
desc: Power x1.10 for each boss beaten while owned.

name: Patience
desc: +12 Power for each race skipped while owned.

name: Recycler
desc: +6 Power for each part sold or replaced while owned.

name: Old Money
desc: +1 Power per $1 you hold (max +40).

name: Broken In
desc: Shift window +3% for each race finished while owned (max +30%).

name: Rear-View Mirror
desc: Copies the race effect of the passive to its right.

name: Tow Hook
desc: Copies the race effect of your leftmost passive.

name: Pole Position
desc: In the leftmost slot: Power x1.12.

name: Convoy
desc: +3% Power for each passive to its left.

name: Coin Flip
desc: Each race: 50% chance of Power x1.35, otherwise Power x0.85.

name: Wild Card
desc: Each race rolls one: Power x1.15, Grip x1.12, Weight x0.92 or Shift window x1.30.

name: Overclock
desc: Power x1.25, but Grip x0.85.

name: Sandbagger
desc: Power x0.90 in regular races, x1.35 in boss races.

name: Boss Hunter
desc: Power x1.15 in boss races.

name: Home Garage
desc: +5% Power per garage upgrade owned.

name: Heat Seeker
desc: +5% Power, plus 5% more per heat level.

name: Ballast
desc: +0.04 Grip per 100 kg the car weighs over 1400 kg.

name: Tag Along
desc: +5% Power per tag you hold.

name: Brand Loyalist
desc: +3% Power per installed part of your most-owned brand (max +18%).

name: Mixed Bag
desc: +4% Power per brand installed, if no brand has more than 2 parts.
